reviews.comment: Dr. Lee Lowery was my mentor at TAMU. I took his Offshore graduate course while an undergrad. The course included Pile Drivability and a study for Mobil O&G.  He inspired me to go into the Offshore O&G Industry where I spent most of my career. I concluded my career at Bechtel as a VP over Offshore Operations. I hold him in the highest of regards.

Prof Lowery is too old to be teaching and that's just the truth. You won't learn at all even if you attend every lecture (you won't even be sure what he's teaching while he's teaching it). But he doesn't fail anyone. Do 1 homework every week even if you haven't started the topic, if you get behind the end of the mester will be a world of hurt.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Go to lecture and pay attention bc he has sign in sheets that determine can help your final grade. He picks on students so don't be late to class or fall asleep bc he will call on you. Lectures overall are worthless and you learn the most from doing the hw. You for the most part just need to know how to set all the problems. Tests are graded light.

Worst professor I have had in my life. Man needs to retire he has no idea how to use technology and it should be a hate crime to keep this man in the education system. Why am I paying so much in tuition to have someone who can't teach me how to tie my shoes teach me how to do "linear programming". Absolutely ridiculous

Lowery is what is flawed with the teacher tenure reform. His class is out dated. He is still teaching the same material he thought 30 years ago, which would be nice if this class didn't involve coding. Get ready to learn ancient coding languages where the only reference to them is in your local library.
Easy-going fellow that tries to be friendly. Very informative on the material. However, I feel like his teaching style and class management can be a little disorganized at times.

Lowery described in one word is "outdated". He made us learn an archaic system called MOR for two thirds of the semester and taught economics so badly I had to teach myself (that was the other third of the semster). Whether you're trying to learn or just get a grade, avoid this professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures are less than useless but he takes attendance, homework problems are ridiculously long and worsened by the fact you'll have no idea how to do them
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Lowery was great for 305! He clarified what was taught in the lecture videos and did plenty of practice problems. His quizzes and final were fair, and pulled heavily from the in-class practice problems. Showing up to class really helps, as each topic builds on the next.

Lowery is a nice and caring person. His lectures though are very boring, repetitive, and all over the place. So, I had to teach myself the material. He randomly takes attendance by calling on students to answer questions. There's a homework every week. His exams were like the previous year's exams on his website, and he is very lenient on grading.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: The dude is just terrible at teaching. You have to learn everything on your own. At this level, it's embarrassing for TAMU to have someone this disconnected from the students learning. I taught myself almost everything and did really well on the exam.

Lowery is definitely a special breed of teacher. He clearly enjoys teaching/working with students and is willing to go the extra mile with you in matters of exams, homework, MASTAN projects, etc. Dry lecture, but an interesting form of comedy that helps lighten the mood. Despite how terrible you may feel after exams just know he has your back.

Lowery was my professor for two classes and my advisor. He has a special breed of humor, but as long as you can take a joke, you will learn a lot! One of the best professors I have ever taken a class from.

We made jokes about how L^3 could teach us more about what George Washington was like in person than civil engineering. Lenient grader & very funny, I enjoyed class but was on my phone more than anything. Teaches with examples, and I made an easy B in the class, but with effort it could've been an A. His website has a lot of helpful material on it

He's a droner. Nice, but speaks softly and puts you to sleep. Sit at the front or you won't be able to follow what he's saying. Weekly quizzes for 60% of your grade. There's a TON of homework for a small amount of credit, but it's good practice. He calls on people during example problems to "take attendance." Nothing unexpected happens in class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests? Not many

reviews.comment: I dont know why everyone is so tough on L^3, Ive definately has much worse professors at TAMU, he genuinely cares about us and his weekly quizzes are not tough, I went on a streak of 7-8 100s in straight weeks and Im way behind in the homework, so the only way to learn was from listening to him lecture. He really isnt bad, Id take him again

Someone else already left literally the perfect description of him: "Dude is the most boring professor and worst lecturer I have had yet. His only redeeming quality is his comedic picking on students. Had to learn the class material from chegg copying the homework, only to get a quiz every week over something completely random." Lowery can't teach.

Lowery is a really nice guy and wants you to understand the material. He just doesn't provide very many examples in class. His lectures can get kinda boring because he is very repetitive. Be prepared to be called on in class

Quiz every Wednesday, called out random names during class to answer questions, don't know what he did with that though. Not good at explaining, talks all over the place and in circles. You just have to use the homework and Chegg to teach yourself. He also said to not go to his office hours so.. that shows how much he cares.

Dude is the most boring professor and worst lecturer I have had yet. His only redeeming quality is his comedic picking on students. Had to learn the class material from chegg copying the homework, only to get a quiz every week over something completely random.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Professor Lowery was a great guy but not a very good professor. His lectures and notes are all difficult to follow so be prepared to use your book/chegg a lot. The quizzes he gives are worth 60% of your grade and he doesn't prepare you for them what-so-ever. Would  have never gone to class if it wasn't for him taking attendance every day.

He's pretty lenient with his class-- he gives the benefit of the doubt to you. Students often keep themselves awake by working on homework online in class and though he may call you out, he typically only does so because he likes to call on students he thinks are worthy of being picked on. Class is slow, but the many baby steps help understand.
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Tests are weighted heavily.  Homework is due during every lecture.  Hilarious professor, but enjoys calling on students during lecture.  Attendance isn't mandatory, but he will call out people's names off of the seating chart and if you aren't there he marks it off.  Who knows if it actually changes your grade though.

Lowery can be confusing at times. When i messed up and got a 60 in my first test i worked so hard just to scrape a B. 3 tests, 30 points each, 10 points are quizzes and homeworks. Overall, above average. If you work for his class, you will reap rewards.
Lectures were dull. He randomly picks names to ask questions. If you're present (even if you get the question wrong) he'll add up to two points to your quiz grade.

I had him in 1998 for Statics/Dynamics. He's a riot, very entertaining and I think his teaching method was great/easy to learn. One problem: he had us in groups of 4 and we took a quiz individually, he gave everyone in that group of 4 the lowest quiz grade. He said that we need to take on the responsibility to help the person with the lowest grade
very interesting proff. to take....funny funny funny!!!!!!!!!!!!  make sure you go to class though
